# Vertica Tips

> In-depth Vertica 25.x technical articles, verified on Vertica v25.4.0-0. Bilingual: Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) and English (en).

Canonical: https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/
Sitemap: https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/sitemap.xml
Author: Achi (https://github.com/achi0012)
Languages: zh-TW, en
License: content is copyright Achi; code samples may be reused with attribution.

## Chinese (zh-TW)

- [Vertica 空間分析實戰：Geospatial 函數與空間索引](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-geospatial-analysis/): Vertica 的 GEOMETRY 用平面座標、GEOGRAPHY 用球面公尺，兩者距離可以差 10%。實測 20 萬個點對 8 個行政區做點在多邊形內：暴力 join 花 7,303–8,661 ms，空間索引只要 827.6 ms，但邊界點 1,602 個不屬於任何區，索引又只是快照，改多邊形不 refresh 就會回 31,251 這個舊答案。
- [Vertica 時序分析實戰：TIMESERIES 插值、補洞與事件視窗](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-timeseries-analysis/): Vertica 的 TIMESERIES 子句會把資料重採樣成完整時間格並插值補洞。實測 98,784 筆 5 分鐘資料產生 103,680 個 slice（多 4,896 個是補出來的），但缺口 15 天時 linear 插值會捏造出 23.89→24.00 的平滑斜坡。成本在切片與插值而非掃描：PROFILE 顯示 Scan 1,061 µs、Analytical 節點 23,446 µs。
- [Vertica 分區表設計與 Partition Pruning 實戰](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-partition-design-pruning/): 實測 Vertica 分區表的 PARTITION BY / GROUP BY 設計、partition pruning、v_monitor.partitions、DROP PARTITION 與 DELETE 的差異，以及 AHM 與 purge 對資料生命週期的影響。
- [Vertica 投影設計實戰：Segmentation、Sort Order、Encoding 與 ROS Pushback](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-projection-design-best-practice/): 從 segmentation、sort order、encoding 到投影數量控管，實測 Vertica 投影設計如何影響 EXPLAIN、資料傾斜與 ROS pushback，並整理可操作的設計檢查表。
- [Vertica 統計資訊管理：ANALYZE_STATISTICS 與查詢計畫為什麼選錯](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-statistics-query-plan/): 從 stale statistics 的角度解釋 Vertica 查詢計畫為什麼選錯，實測 ANALYZE_STATISTICS 前後的 EXPLAIN、資料列估算與 join order 變化，並整理統計資訊的維護策略。
- [Vertica 25.4 VectorOps 實戰：用 ARRAY 做向量相似度搜尋](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-vectorops-array-similarity-search/): 在 Vertica 25.4 用 ARRAY[FLOAT] 儲存 embedding，實測 COSINE_SIMILARITY、DOT_PRODUCT、VECTOR_L2、VECTOR_MAGNITUDE，打造 Top-K 向量相似度搜尋，並解析沒有向量索引時的效能取捨。
- [Vertica 空間審計實戰 — 別數 ROS 容器，算位元組（25.4 實測）](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/11/vertica-space-audit/): 68.20 GB 的 Vertica 25.4 實測空間審計：1,254 個 ROS 容器只佔 0.03 GB、164 張 0 bytes 表、288,920 列未 purge 的刪除。四組系統表 SQL 與回收動作對照。
- [Vertica 資源池管理最佳實踐 — 從分類到串聯的完整調校指南](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-resource-pool-best-practice/): Vertica 資源池 (Resource Pool) 的完整管理指南 — 從五個核心參數、工作量分類方法、兩家企業的實戰演進（6 階段調校）、串聯資源池、執行時間路由、優先級排程，到監控與調校檢查清單。
- [Vertica Tuple Mover 最佳實踐 — Moveout、Mergeout 與 STRATA 演算法完整指南](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-tuple-mover-best-practice/): Vertica Tuple Mover 的完整最佳實踐指南 — 從 Moveout/Mergeout 運作原理、STRATA 演算法、TM 資源池調優、Part 1 (9.1-) 與 Part 2 (9.2+) 的版本差異，到 ROS Pushback 預防與實戰監控。
- [Vertica 刪除資料最佳實踐 — DELETE、TRUNCATE、Partition 完整指南](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-delete-data-best-practice/): Vertica 刪除資料的完整最佳實踐 — DELETE 運作原理、五種刪除方式對比 (Single Row / Bulk / Drop Partition / Truncate)、Delete Vectors 管理、PurgeMergeoutPercent 調校、以及替代 DELETE 的實戰技巧。
- [Vertica 資料庫崩潰後啟動失敗 — ASR 日期異常的完整復原指南](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-asr-recovery/): Vertica 資料庫因斷電或檔案系統問題崩潰後啟動失敗，ASR 顯示無效日期（2001 年或更早）時的完整復原步驟 — 從 Unsafe Mode 啟動、epoch 分析、abortrecovery 到資料搶救。
- [理解 Linux OOM Kill 在 Vertica 叢集中的成因與預防 — 完整指南](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-oom-prevention/): 深入解析 Vertica 叢集中 Linux OOM Killer 的成因與預防 — 從 MAXMEMORYSIZE 調校、Catalog 記憶體計算、MemoryReport.log 診斷、glibc 版本問題，到 ROS/Delete Vectors 管理。
- [Vertica v26.2 NUMA Aware 效能架構 — 單伺服器跑出 3 倍吞吐量](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-v26.2-numa-performance/): Vertica v26.2 Beta 引入的 NUMA-aware 架構深度解析 — NUMA 原理、壓力測試結果（單伺服器 3.19× 吞吐提升）、硬體規格建議、多節點部署流程與成本節省效益。
- [Vertica Log Analysis 實戰 — 從系統表到日誌檔的根因分析指南](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-log-analysis-rca/): 系統化的 Vertica 日誌分析流程 — 從 Data Collector 歷史保留、監控查詢最佳化、QUERY_EVENTS 健康/異常期比對，到 vertica.log 的嚴重程度分析與精準時段定位。
- [Vertica ML 實戰：自我監控與智慧調優 — 25.4.0-0 完全驗證](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-ml-self-optimization/): 使用 Vertica 25.4.0-0 內建的 Machine Learning 函數（LINEAR_REG、SVM_CLASSIFIER、KMEANS、IFOREST、RF_CLASSIFIER、LOGISTIC_REG）建立智慧監控與自動調優系統，所有 SQL 皆經實際驗證。
- [Vertica 資料庫效能變慢怎麼辦？— 13 步驟診斷檢查清單 (25.x 更新版)](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-slow-performance-checklist/): Vertica 資料庫效能變慢時的 13 步驟系統化診斷檢查清單 — 從節點狀態、Delete Vectors、Epoch 推進、資源佇列、鎖衝突、到 Catalog 記憶體用量，附 25.x 版本差異對照。
- [Vertica + Apache Iceberg 實戰指南 — 打造高效 Data Lakehouse](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-iceberg-lakehouse/): 深入解析 Vertica 與 Apache Iceberg 的整合 — 從架構概念、功能演進對照表，到五大實戰範例：AWS Glue、檔案系統表、Lakekeeper REST Catalog、Nessie OAuth2 與 Bearer Token 認證。
- [Vertica Health Watchdog 深度解析 — 叢集健康監控的自動守護神](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-health-watchdog/): Vertica 24.4+ 引入的 Health Watchdog 功能深度解析 — 揭露四大監控模組（Truncation Version Lag、GCLX Queue、Mergeout Queue、Memory Pushback）的運作原理、閾值配置，以及 24 個常見 QA 總整理。
- [Vertica Smart Scanning 加速外部表查詢 — ObjectStoreGlobStrategy 深度解析](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-smart-scanning-external-tables/): Vertica 23.4+ 引入的 ObjectStoreGlobStrategy 如何透過分層掃描（Hierarchical Strategy）將外部表查詢加速 88%？本文深入解析 Flat 與 Hierarchical 兩種策略的運作原理、實測對比與最佳實踐。
- [Vertica 集群重新平衡實戰指南 — Cluster Rebalancing (25.x)](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-rebalancing-best-practice/): Vertica 集群增減節點後的完整 Rebalancing 指南 — 從架構流程、資源池調優、四階段搬運機制，到鎖衝突處理與分批排程策略。基於 Vertica 25.4.0-0 實測經驗。
- [Vertica 節點故障恢復實戰指南 — Node Down Recovery (25.x)](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-node-recovery-best-practice/): Vertica 節點故障後的完整恢復指南 — 從節點狀態轉換、Recovery 兩階段流程、資源池調優，到 Dirty Transaction 處理與 5 大常見問題排解。基於 Vertica 25.4.0-0 實測經驗。
- [Vertica Data Load 最佳實踐 — COPY 命令深度解析 (25.x)](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/2026/06/vertica-data-load-best-practice/): 深入解析 Vertica 25.x 的 COPY 命令架構、資源池調優、配置參數最佳化，以及 8 大常見瓶頸情境的實戰排解方案。基於 Vertica 25.4.0-0 實測經驗。

## English (en)

- [Vertica Geospatial Analysis: Functions and Spatial Indexes in Practice](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-geospatial-analysis/): In Vertica, GEOMETRY works in planar units and GEOGRAPHY in metres, and the same two points can differ by 10%. On 200,000 points against 8 district polygons the brute-force join took 7,303-8,661 ms while the spatial index took 827.6 ms - but 1,602 boundary points belong to no polygon at all, and the index is a snapshot that still answered 31,251 after a polygon changed.
- [Vertica Time Series Analysis: TIMESERIES Interpolation, Gap Filling, and Event Windows](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-timeseries-analysis/): Vertica's TIMESERIES clause resamples data onto a fixed time grid and interpolates the holes. On 98,784 five-minute readings it produced 103,680 slices - 4,896 of them synthetic - and over a 15-day outage linear interpolation invented a smooth 23.89 to 24.00 ramp. The cost is in slicing and interpolation, not scanning: PROFILE shows Scan at 1,061 us and the Analytical node at 23,446 us.
- [Vertica Partition Table Design and Partition Pruning in Practice](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-partition-design-pruning/): Benchmark Vertica partitioned table design with PARTITION BY and GROUP BY, partition pruning, v_monitor.partitions, DROP PARTITION versus DELETE, and how AHM and purge affect the data lifecycle.
- [Vertica Projection Design in Practice: Segmentation, Sort Order, Encoding, and ROS Pushback](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-projection-design-best-practice/): From segmentation and sort order to encoding and projection count, benchmark how Vertica projection design affects EXPLAIN plans, data skew, and ROS pushback, with a practical design checklist.
- [Vertica Statistics Management: Why the Optimizer Chooses the Wrong Plan](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-statistics-query-plan/): Explain why the Vertica optimizer chooses the wrong plan when statistics are stale, benchmark EXPLAIN before and after ANALYZE_STATISTICS, compare row estimates and join order, and build a practical statistics maintenance strategy.
- [Vertica 25.4 VectorOps in Practice: Vector Similarity Search with ARRAY](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-vectorops-array-similarity-search/): Store embeddings as ARRAY[FLOAT] in Vertica 25.4, benchmark COSINE_SIMILARITY, DOT_PRODUCT, VECTOR_L2, and VECTOR_MAGNITUDE, and build a Top-K vector similarity search while understanding the performance trade-offs without a vector index.
- [Auditing Vertica Disk Space: Don't Count ROS Containers, Count Bytes (25.4 Measured)](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/11/vertica-space-audit/): Measured on Vertica 25.4: 1,254 of 1,524 ROS containers hold just 0.03 GB. Four audit queries, empty-table detection, and a reclaim-action table.
- [Vertica Resource Pool Best Practices — From Custom Pools to Cascading (25.x)](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/06/vertica-resource-pool-best-practice/): Vertica resource pool management — five core parameters, workload classification, fastAnalytics evolution, and a tuning checklist.
- [Vertica Tuple Mover Best Practices — Mergeout, STRATA & TM Pool Tuning (25.x)](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/06/vertica-tuple-mover-best-practice/): Vertica Tuple Mover best practices — Mergeout mechanics, STRATA algorithm, TM pool tuning, ROS pushback, changes through 25.x.
- [Best Practices for Deleting Data in Vertica — DELETE, TRUNCATE, Partition Guide (25.x)](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/06/vertica-delete-data-best-practice/): Deleting data in Vertica — how DELETE works, five methods compared, delete vectors, PurgeMergeoutPercent, and DELETE alternatives.
- [Vertica Database Fails to Start After Crash — ASR Invalid Date Recovery Guide](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/06/vertica-asr-recovery/): Vertica won't start after a crash with ASR showing invalid dates? Unsafe Mode, epoch analysis, abortrecovery, and data salvage.
- [Understanding Linux OOM Kills in Vertica Clusters — Prevention Guide](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/06/vertica-oom-prevention/): Linux OOM killer in Vertica clusters — MAXMEMORYSIZE, catalog memory sizing, MemoryReport.log, glibc versions, ROS and delete vectors.
- [Vertica v26.2 NUMA-Aware Performance — 3x Throughput on a Single Server](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/06/vertica-v26.2-numa-performance/): Vertica v26.2 NUMA-aware architecture — principles, stress test results (3.19x throughput on one server), and deployment savings.
- [Vertica Log Analysis for Root Cause Investigation — A Practical Guide](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/06/vertica-log-analysis-rca/): Vertica log analysis workflow — Data Collector retention, monitoring query tuning, QUERY_EVENTS comparison, vertica.log severity analysis.
- [Vertica ML for Self-Monitoring and Smart Tuning (25.4 Verified)](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/06/vertica-ml-self-optimization/): Using Vertica 25.4.0-0 built-in ML functions (LINEAR_REG, KMEANS, IFOREST, RF_CLASSIFIER) for self-monitoring and auto-tuning.
- [Vertica Performance Slow? — 13-Step Diagnostic Checklist (25.x Updated)](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/06/vertica-slow-performance-checklist/): A 13-step diagnostic checklist for Vertica slowdowns — updated to 25.x with the correct system table locations for each step.
- [Vertica + Apache Iceberg: Building a High-Performance Data Lakehouse](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/06/vertica-iceberg-lakehouse/): Vertica + Apache Iceberg integration — architecture, feature matrix 12.0.4→25.4.0, and five hands-on examples (Glue, Lakekeeper, Nessie).
- [Vertica Health Watchdog Deep Dive — Automatic Cluster Monitoring (24.4+)](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/06/vertica-health-watchdog/): Vertica Health Watchdog (24.4+) explained — four monitoring modules, threshold tuning, and 24 FAQ answers for early warning.
- [Vertica Smart Scanning — Faster External Table Queries with ObjectStoreGlobStrategy](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/06/vertica-smart-scanning-external-tables/): How Vertica 23.4+ ObjectStoreGlobStrategy speeds up external table queries by 88.5% — Flat vs Hierarchical scanning, benchmarked.
- [Vertica Cluster Rebalancing Field Guide (25.x)](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/06/vertica-rebalancing-best-practice/): Rebalancing a Vertica cluster after adding or removing nodes — four-phase process, REFRESH pool tuning, locks, batch strategies.
- [Vertica Node Down Recovery Field Guide — Practical Guide (25.x)](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/06/vertica-node-recovery-best-practice/): Recovering a failed Vertica node — state transitions, two-phase recovery, RECOVERY pool tuning, dirty transactions, 5 scenarios.
- [Vertica Data Load Best Practices — COPY Command Deep Dive (25.x)](https://achi0012.github.io/vertica-tips/en/2026/06/vertica-data-load-best-practice/): Vertica 25.x COPY architecture, resource pool and parameter tuning, plus 8 real-world loading bottlenecks — verified on 25.4.0-0.
